audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer rated all seven rows 'Skill' while the content layer and packet levelChart both flip to Lissandra from Levels 4-5 onward. The page rendered two different charts.
audit.why: The whys already argue Lissandra from level 4 (her E on 12s, no dash before 6) and from 6 (Frozen Tomb cancels the Pop Blossom preparation). Only the full-layer side values were stale.
audit.corrected: phases[3..6].side to Lissandra with ratings raised; win[N] already carries Lissandra on those rows, so the layers now agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why was the generic anti-assassin template and said nothing about what actually changes at 6 in this lane.
audit.why: Pop Blossom has a preparation phase before the leap and knockup, and the preparation is hidden while she is disguised. Frozen Tomb on her during that window removes the stun entirely.
audit.corrected: Rewrote phases[4].why and dosFull[1].d around tombing the Pop Blossom preparation.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit, and the page never mentioned that Tangle-Barbs grows larger, faster and longer-rooting if it passes through a champion or kills a unit first.
audit.why: That growth is the reason to stand behind minions rather than beside a teammate — a detail the generic 'sidestep it' line does not convey.
audit.corrected: Stated Tangle-Barbs at 12s rank 1 / 10s maxed with the growth clause, and Pop Blossom at 120s rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer credited the root to W (Shapesplitter) in wants.foe[0] and repeatedly called W a 'stealth'.
audit.why: W sends a clone and grants move speed with a third-attack proc; it is not a root and not stealth. The root is E, Tangle-Barbs. The disguise is the passive, Inherent Glamour.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[0] now names E (Tangle-Barbs); the stealth phrasing was replaced with the clone and the fact she has no dash before 6.

audit.why: 52.95% over 1135 games supports the EVEN 5.5/10 framing.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are an even trade fight: Neeko's Q poke and W movement speed let her harass and slip away, but she's immobile once her stealth is down. Match her cooldowns, space with E, and don't overextend into her clone tricks.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are an even trade fight: Neeko's Q poke and W move speed let her harass and slip away, but she has no dash at all before 6. Match her cooldowns, space with E, and don't overextend into her clone tricks.
